label: Diagram 2.23
caption: Diagram 2.23 Wall type 2 – internal timber floor | Junctions with internal concrete floors
description: The image contains two line drawings, each captioned "SECTION". The left drawing sits beneath a green header reading "Diagram 2.23 Wall type 2 – internal timber floor". It shows two vertical wall members, each filled with a diagonal cross‑hatch pattern and drawn as two separate faces with a gap between them. Horizontal lines representing the floor structure project outwards from each wall; a triangular bracket is drawn where the lines meet each wall, and on the left wall a leader line from the word "Hanger" points to a small element at the foot of that bracket. The right drawing shows two adjoining buildings in section, joined by a central wall drawn with a diagonal cross‑hatch pattern as two faces with a gap and a break line in the middle. At the top of each building is an unlabelled concrete slab. On the left, a slab labelled "Concrete slab ground floor" lies at the level of a horizontal line marked "Ground", and the wall descends through that line to a dotted foundation block at the bottom. On the right, a slab labelled "Suspended concrete ground floor" is elevated above a second horizontal line marked "Ground" to its right and rests on the wall at its left end, with a row of small circles drawn in the void beneath the slab; the wall continues down to the same dotted foundation.
